chapter.verse: Tu-in Paisan Pawi a kici Silngo Sawhloh Anlum Pawi hun nai ta hi.
Siampi liante leh laisiamte in Jesu thah theih nading thu zong uh hi. A hang pen mihonpi kihta uh hi.
Tua ciangin sawmlenihte lakah khat ahi Iscariot a kici Judas a sungah Satan in mun la hi.
Amah paikhia-in siampi liante leh biakinncing bute' kiangah Jesu a lehhek theih dingzia va kuppih hi.
Amaute lungdam uh a, sum tawh guaih ding kithukim uh hi.
Amah zong lungkimin mihonpi' theih loh kalin amaute' kiangah Jesu a lehhek theih nading hunpha khat zon kipan hi.
Tua ciangin Paisan Pawi tuuno a kigawh ding hun, Silngo Sawhloh Anlum Pawi ni hong tung hi.
Jesu in Peter leh John sawl a, "Va pai unla i nek dingin ei' ading Paisan Pawi an va bawl un," ci hi.
Amaute in, "Koi ah kong bawlsak ding uh deih na hi hiam?" ci uh hi.
Jesu in hih bangin gen hi: "En un, khuapi sung na lut uh ciangin tuibeel pua pasal khat tawh na kituak ding uh hi. Ama' lutna inn a sungah zui unla,
inntekpa' kiangah, 'Syapa in, "Ka nungzuite tawh Paisan Pawi an ka nek nading lengla inndei koi tak hiam?" ci hi,' ci un.
Amah in innsung vanzat teng a baihsa-a kikoihna inndei tungnung a zaipi khat hong lak ding hi. Tua lai ah na bawl un."
Amaute zong pai-in Jesu' gen bang lian tuak uh a, Paisan Pawi an bawl uh hi.
Hunlenai a tun ciangin sabuai ah Jesu tu a, sawltakte zong amah tawh om uh hi.
Tua ciangin Jesu in amaute' kiangah, "Sihna ka thuak ma-in note tawh hih Paisan Pawi an nekkhop ding nakpi ka lunggulh hi.
A hang pen Pasian' kumpigam ah Paisan Pawi thu a tangtun mateng Paisan Pawi an ka ne nawn kei ding hi," ci hi.
Tua ciangin hai khat la a, hehpih a phat khit ciangin, "Hih la unla no teng in hawm un.
A hang pen tu-a kipan Pasian' kumpigam hong tun mateng lenggui pana piang ka dawn kei ding hi," ci hi.
Anlum zong la-in hehpih a phat khit ciangin balnenin amaute pia a, "Hih pen note' adinga hong kipia keima' pumpi ahi hi. Kei nong phawkna-un hih bangin na hih un," ci hi.
Tua mah bangin an a nek khit uh ciangin hai la a, "Note' adinga a luangkhia hih hai pen keima' sisan sunga om thuciamna thak ahi hi.
Ahih hangin, en un, kei hong lehhekpa' khut pen kei tawh sabuai kikhatin om hi.
A hang pen Mihing' Tapa ahihleh a kisehsa bangin a pai ding hi a, ahi zongin amah a lehhek mipa ahihleh a dahhuaizia!" ci hi.
Tua ciangin tua banga gamta ding pen amau teng lakah a kua pen hiding ci-in nungzuite khatlekhat dot kipan uh hi.
Tua banah amau teng lakah kua a thupipen hiding cih vai-in amau teng kikal ah kiselna khat piang hi.
Tua ciangin Jesu in amaute' kiangah hih bangin gen hi: "Gentile kumpite mipi' tungah kithuneisak uh a, tua banga amau' tungah uktheihna thu a neite pen thupha hong bawlteb ci-in kisam hi.
No na hih uhleh na tuaci kei ding uh hi. Tua sangin note' laka a thupipente a moipente bang hi uh henla vaihawm makaite mi a vil a donte bang hizaw uh hen.
A hang pen sabuai-a tupa leh sabuai vilpa kua thupizaw hiam? Sabuai-a tupa thupizaw hilo hiam? Himah taleh kei pen note' lakah nasempa bangin kong om hi.
"Note pen zia-et ka thuak laitak kei hong ompihte na hi uh hi.
Ka pa in kumpigam khat kei hong guat mah bangin ke'n zong note kong guan hi.
Tua hi a, note pen ka kumpigam sunga ka sabuai ah anne tuidawnin na om thei ding uh a, kumpitokhom tungah tu-in Israel beh sawmlenihte' tungah thukhenin na om ding uh hi.
"Simon, Simon aw, en in, Satan in note buhtang bangin hong haihkhia nuamin kutna hong bawl khin a,
ahi zongin na upna na khahsuah loh nadingin nang' ading kong thum sak khin hi. Nong kiheikik ciangin na sanggamte na thakhauhsak in."
Peter in, "Topa aw, thong ahi-a sihna ahi zongin nang tawh kithuah dingin a kigingsa-in ka om hi," ci hi.
Jesu in, "Peter aw, ke'n kong cihin ah kei nong theih thu thumvei na nial mateng tuni ak khuang lo ding hi," ci hi.
Tua ciangin Jesu in amaute' kiangah, "Note, sumbawm, thung-ip, khedap cihte lo tawh kong sawlkhiat lai-in kitangsap khatpeuh na nei uh hiam?" ci hi. Amaute in, "Nei lo," ci uh hi.
Jesu in, "Ahi zongin tu-in ahihleh sumbawm neite in sumbawm keng ta hen. Thung-ip neite in zong thung-ip keng ta hen. Namsau a neilo peuhmah in a puantual zuak henla namsau lei ta hen.

A hang pen ke'n kong cihin ah, 'Thukhun palsatte tawh amah kisimkhawm hi,' a cihna hih Pasian' Laibu sunga thu kei' tungah hong tangtunloh phamawh hi. A hang pen kei' vai a kigelh thu pen a tangtung ding thu ahi hi," ci hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in, "Topa aw, en in. Hih takah namsau nih om hi," ci uh hi. Jesu in, "Phazo hi," ci-in dawng hi.
Tua ciangin Jesu paikhia a, ama' hihngeizia bangin Olive Mual zuan hi. Nungzuite in zong amah zui uh hi.
A mun a tun ciangin Jesu in amaute' kiangah, "Zia-etnaf sung na pukkhak loh nadingun thungen un," ci hi.
Tua ciangin amaute' kiangpan suanglot tan khat kinphei-in khukdinin thungen a,
"Pa aw, na ut leh hih hai kei' kiangpan hemkhia in. Ahi zongin kei' deihna hilo, nang' deihna bang hizaw hen," ci hi. [
Tua ciangin vantung pan vanmi khat ama' kiangah kilangin Jesuh thadimsak hi.
Tua ciangin lunggim mahmah ahih manin nakpi-in thungetbeh a, a khua-ulte sisan taak golpite bangin leilak ah kia hi.]g
Thungetna pan a dintoh ciangin nungzuite' kiangah a pai leh amaute dahna hangin gimin a na ihmut uh tuakkha ahih manin
Jesu in, "Bang hangin ihmu na hi uh hiam? Tho unla zia-etna sung na pukkhak loh nadingun thungen un," ci hi.
Tua bangin Jesu a pau laitak mah, mi honkhat hong pai uh a, sawmlenihte lakpan Judas a kici mipa in amaute makaih hi. Judas in Jesu nam dingin nehphei hi.
Ahih hangin Jesu in, "Judas aw, napna tawh Mihing' Tapa lehhek ding na hiam?"ci hi.
Jesu' kiim om mite in a piang ding thu a muh uh ciangin, "Topa aw, namsau tawh ka sat ding uh hiam?" ci-in dong uh hi.
Amaute lakah khat in siampi lianpenpa' silapa sat a, a taklam bil satkhiakha hi.
Jesu in, "Tuaci nawn ke'n!" a cih khit ciangin silapa' bil lawngin damsak hi.
Tua ciangin Jesu in amah a man dinga hong kuan siampi liante, biakinnpi uliante leh Jew makaite' kiangah, "Guta buluh khat a man ding bangin namsau leh molhtum tawh hong kuankhia na hi uh hiam?
Nisim mahin biakinnpi ah note tawh ka om a, bangmah nong cih kei uh hi. Tu-in ahihleh note' hunlenai hi a, hih pen khuamial thuneihna ahi hi," ci hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in Jesu manin paikhiatpih uh a, siampi lianpenpa' inn tunpih uh hi. Peter in zong a gamla mun khat pan zui hi.
Siampi lianpenpa' zum inntual laizang ah amaute meiphual cihin a tutsuk uh ciangin Peter zong amau lakah va tu hi.
Sawltangzang numei khat in mei' taanna muna tu Peter a muh ciangin naitak en a, "Hih pa zong amah tawh kikhawl hi," ci hi.
Ahih hangin Peter in nial a, "Numei aw, ke'n amah ka thei kei hi," ci hi.
A den deuh ciangin midang khat in Peter mu ahih manin, "Nang zong amaute laka kihel khat na hi hi," ci hi. Ahi zongin Peter in, "Pasal aw, ka hikei hi," ci hi.
Nai khat khit khawng ding ciangin midang khat in, "Hih mipa zong Galilee mi ahih manin amah tawh kithuah taktak hi," ci-in khauhtak gen hi.
Ahih hangin Peter in, "Pasal aw, na thugen bang hiam cih ka thei kei hi," ci hi. Tua bangin thu a gen laitak lianin ak khuang hi.
Tua ciangin Topa in a lu hei-in Peter en hi. Peter in zong ama' tunga Topa' gen thu, "Tuni ak khuan ma-in thumvei nong nial ding hi," a cih phawkkik hi.
Tua ciangin amah paikhia-in nakpitak kap hi.
Tu-in Jesu a cing mite in amah zahko-in sat uh hi.
A mit tuamin thu dongdong uh a, "Kamsang dih in! Tu-a hong beeng kua ahi hiam?" ci uh hi.
Tua banah ama' langkhat ah daisakna kam tampi pau uh hi.
Khuavak ciangin mipi makaite kikaikhawmin siampi liante leh laisiamte tawh kikhopna bawlkhawm uh hi. Tua ciangin Sanhedrin ah Jesu paipih uh a,
"Nang Khris na hihleh hong kigen in," ci uh hi. Ahih hangin Jesu in, "Hong gen le-ing na um kei ding uh a,
hong dong le-ing nong dawng kei ding uh hi.
Himah taleh Mihing' Tapa pen tu-a kipan Pasian' vangliatna taklam ah tu ding hi," ci hi.
Tua hangin amaute khempeuh in, "Tua ahihleh nang Pasian' Tapa na hi hiam?" ci uh hi. Jesu in, "Hi nong ci uh hi," ci hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in, "Teci dang bang kisam nawn i hi hiam? Eimahmah in ama' kam pan i za khinta hi," ci uh hi.Pilate' kiangah Jesu Kipuak
